note: One detection model for every class that hides. The server owns it. The client only draws the meter.

distance_term.formula: linear from range_pts_at_closest at 2 m to range_pts_far at the effective range

facing_term.formula: 100 inside the front arc, 50 on the flanks, 0 behind

concealment_term.formula: 1 - concealment, 0.55 for a cloak, 1.0 for nothing

rules: Never a binary aura. No class sees every hidden enemy on the field.
Reveal effects beat the meter instantly but only inside their own shape.
A detection pulse breaks enemy stealth only; allies are exempt.
Firing a weapon breaks the cloak. Moving fast doubles the rate you are seen.
The meter, not the model, decides. A player never dies without having been given a chance to know they were seen.
